topic.label: Mapping and GIS
topic.desc: Mapping and GIS: Map Types, Dimensions, Survey and Capture Methods, Web Mapping and Geocoding, Spatial Data and GIS, SLAM - Simultaneous Localization and Mapping and Coordinate Systems and Projections.

concepts.label: Coordinate Systems and Projections
concepts.desc: Datums, coordinate reference systems and map projections.

concepts.label: Dimensions
concepts.desc: Mapping in two, two-and-a-half, three and four dimensions.

concepts.label: Spatial Data and GIS
concepts.desc: Spatial file formats, queries and cartographic design.

concepts.label: SLAM - Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
concepts.desc: Building a map of an unknown place while estimating the sensor's own position in it, with visual and LiDAR methods.

concepts.label: Survey and Capture Methods
concepts.desc: How spatial data is captured: GNSS and RTK, photogrammetry, LiDAR scanning and remote sensing.

concepts.label: Map Types
concepts.desc: Kinds of map: topographic, thematic, road network, indoor and occupancy maps.

concepts.label: Web Mapping and Geocoding
concepts.desc: Geocoding, map tiles and routing services for web and mobile maps.

skills.label: Coordinate Reference System Transformer
skills.desc: Transforms coordinates between datums and projections and reports the expected error of each transformation.

skills.label: Projection Selector
skills.desc: Selects a projection for a region and purpose by which distortion matters, such as area, distance or shape.

skills.label: Point Cloud and Mesh Processor
skills.desc: Filters, registers and meshes three-dimensional point clouds and reports density and noise.

skills.label: Elevation Surface Model Builder
skills.desc: Builds elevation and surface models from points or imagery and separates ground from objects.

skills.label: Temporal Change Detector
skills.desc: Compares maps or scans from different dates to find real change and separates it from registration error.

skills.label: Cartographic Designer
skills.desc: Designs a legible map layout with labels, color and legend for a stated audience.

skills.label: Spatial Format Converter
skills.desc: Converts between GeoJSON, shapefile, GeoTIFF and GeoPackage and reports attributes or precision lost in conversion.

skills.label: Spatial Query Analyst
skills.desc: Runs overlay, buffer, join and proximity analysis on layers and explains the result with its caveats.

skills.label: LiDAR SLAM
skills.desc: Registers successive LiDAR scans into a map and a trajectory with scan matching and optional inertial data.

skills.label: Loop Closure and Pose Graph Optimization
skills.desc: Detects revisited places and optimizes the pose graph to remove accumulated drift, rejecting false loop closures.

skills.label: SLAM Evaluation
skills.desc: Evaluates a SLAM run against ground truth with absolute and relative trajectory error and map accuracy.

skills.label: Visual SLAM
skills.desc: Estimates camera motion and builds a sparse or dense map from monocular, stereo or depth images using features and keyframes, and states the scale ambiguity of a single camera.

skills.label: GNSS and RTK Surveyor
skills.desc: Plans GNSS and RTK surveys with base station setup, occupation time and ground control points and reports accuracy.

skills.label: LiDAR Scan Planner
skills.desc: Plans terrestrial, mobile or airborne LiDAR scans for point density and coverage and notes occlusions.

skills.label: Photogrammetry Planner
skills.desc: Plans image capture and processing for a three-dimensional model with overlap, camera calibration and check points.

skills.label: Remote Sensing Analyst
skills.desc: Works with satellite and aerial imagery for land cover, change and indices and states resolution limits.

skills.label: Indoor and Occupancy Mapper
skills.desc: Builds indoor floor plans and occupancy grids from scans or sensor data and marks unknown space explicitly.

skills.label: Road Network Builder
skills.desc: Builds a routable road network graph with turn restrictions and speed attributes and checks connectivity.

skills.label: Topographic and Thematic Mapper
skills.desc: Chooses map type, scale and symbology for a purpose and builds thematic maps from attribute data.

skills.label: Geocoder
skills.desc: Converts addresses to coordinates and back and returns the match quality of each result.

skills.label: Routing Service Integrator
skills.desc: Integrates a routing service for directions and travel times and tests edge cases such as closures and one-way streets.

skills.label: Map Tile Publisher
skills.desc: Prepares vector or raster tiles and a basemap style for web display and sets zoom levels and caching.

mcp.name: TomTom Maps
mcp.desc: TomTom maps, routing, geocoding & traffic data

mcp.name: Felt Maps
mcp.desc: Map and analyze your geospatial data

mcp.name: GIS Cloud
mcp.desc: Run your entire GIS workflow in plain language: maps, data, analysis, field apps, and reports

mcp.name: Google Maps MCP
mcp.desc: Google Maps Platform MCP server: geocoding and reverse geocoding of addresses and coordinates, place search and place details, distance matrix, elevation and directions.

mcp.name: Mapbox MCP Server
mcp.desc: Mapbox location MCP server: forward and reverse geocoding, points of interest search, directions and travel-time isochrones, static map images.

mcp.name: OpenStreetMap MCP
mcp.desc: OpenStreetMap MCP server: geocode addresses and place names to coordinates, find nearby places, route between locations, explore neighborhoods from open map data.
